edits.old: Then the grant refuses the access and the boundary test fails the build, with the pipeline log as the only record
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the access and the boundary test fails the build, with the pipeline log as the only record

  Scenario: AC16 A contract call past the 2 s budget or with the breaker open changes no state (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the intake creation of a submission misses the 2 s budget or its breaker is open
    When the reconcile run retries the intake call
    Then the row stays in state PENDING, no second row or event is written, and the partner sees MSG-GEN-006 as queued

  Scenario: AC17 A test that reaches a document, document_intake, recovery_case or ledger table outside rwb_partner is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a test of this service reads or writes a document, document_intake, recovery_case or ledger table
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the access and the build fails, with the pipeline log as the only record

  Scenario: AC18 A contract read or call that misses the 2 s budget changes nothing and is retried once with jitter (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a contract read or call of this service misses the 2 s budget
    When the call times out
    Then no column changes and no record, row or event is written, and the call is retried once with jitter

  Scenario: AC19 A call to a provided operation without valid credentials answers 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds no valid credentials
    When the caller calls the submission operation of /api/recovery/partner/v1
    Then the answer is 401, and no partner_intake row, decision record or event is written

  Scenario: AC20 A redelivered consumed event changes no state (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the attach event for "TI-0001" on case "RW-2026-000123" has been consumed once
    When the same attach event is redelivered
    Then partner_intake holds state "MATCHED" unchanged, PartnerInstructionWorkflow receives no second documentAttached signal, and no row is added to the inbox or outbox

  Scenario: AC21 A reconcile activity that times out is retried once and writes no second record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the reconcile run calls the intake for a submission and the activity times out at the 2 s budget
    When the activity is retried once with jitter
    Then no second partner_intake row and no second PartnerDocumentSubmitted event is written
